summary: Iteration 133 — FRONTEND ONLY (real preview URL, admin@mikilab.de). Verified (A) new on-page ToolsDirectory grouped by FUNCTION, (B) drawer regrouped by TOOL_KINDS, (C) combo cloud/sync indicator, (D) theme + regressions. RESULTS — DIRECTORY: 'maestro-tools-directory' renders under the AI generator; all 4 sections present (tools-dir-kind-genera/gestione/registri/info); 'genera' open by default (tools-dir-tool-metodo visible, tools-dir-tool-foodcost hidden); tools-dir-toggle-<kind> works as an accordion (opening 'gestione' closed 'genera'; clicking the same toggle collapses it); tiles open the right tool: tools-dir-tool-haccp -> 'HACCP Log' screen with maestro-back-btn (directory unmounted), back returns to the directory; tools-dir-tool-metodo and tools-dir-tool-foodcost also open + back OK. DRAWER: lab-menu-open opens lab-menu-drawer; exactly 1 of each lab-menu-kind-genera/gestione/registri/info; ZERO legacy lab-menu-cat-* nodes; lab-menu-tool-foodcost opens the tool and auto-closes the drawer; lab-menu-close closes it. COMBO CLOUD ICON: planner via localStorage mikilab_pending_tool=pianoai; recipe added (capo-add-picker-trigger -> cat -> item -> done, 6 categories / items OK); combo TEST_Cloud133 saved -> chip 'TEST_Cloud133 · 1' with capo-combo-synced-c_1788097876705 Cloud icon rendered immediately after the POST /api/combos/sync resolved (<1s), computed color rgb(174,184,191) = #AEB8BF neutral grey (spec-compliant). PERSISTENCE: localStorage mikilab_combos cleared + full reload while logged in -> hydrated from account with synced:true, chip + cloud icon re-rendered. Deleting the chip (capo-combo-del-<id>) removed it and GET /api/combos returned [] (cleanup complete, admin account left with 0 combos). THEME: body bg rgb(18,18,18); programmatic scan of every node inside maestro-tools-directory found NO bright-blue color/background/border (group accents are orange #ff6b00 / amber #A16207 / brown #8C6B4A / #ff8a33). REGRESSION: global site menu (site-menu-open -> site-menu) still groups by cat: 5 cat groups, 44 tools, site-menu-tool-foodcost opens correctly; quick tile maestro-top-metodo opens correctly. Tested desktop 1920x900 and mobile 430x900 (directory readable, 2-col tiles, accordion + tool open work). NO console pageerror in any of the 3 runs.

issues: The onboarding coach bubble ('Hi, I'm Mohammadreza…' with Skip/Next) re-appears on every reload/login and floats over the planner + tools directory content; it is dismissible and did not block any click, but it repeatedly covers the lower part of the page during navigation (minor, pre-existing).

critical_code_review_comments: ToolsDirectory is an exclusive accordion (single `open` state): opening one group collapses the others. Works and matches the described behaviour, but if multi-open is desired use a Set.

Duplication: the drawer in PianoProduzioneAI.jsx and ToolsDirectory.jsx both re-implement the TOOL_KINDS -> TOOLS.filter(kind) grouping + tile markup (~15 lines each). Consider a shared <ToolKindGroup> to avoid divergence.

Carry-over from iteration 132 (still valid): combos.js saveCombo/hydrateCombos fire-and-forget the sync and swallow ALL errors (.catch(() => {})). With the new cloud icon this becomes user-visible: on a 5xx/offline failure the chip silently stays WITHOUT the cloud icon and the user gets no explanation/retry. Suggest distinguishing 401 (guest) from real failures and showing a warning.

PianoProduzioneAI.jsx is very large (>800 lines with TOOLS/TOOL_CATS/TOOL_KINDS data + drawer + planner). The TOOLS/TOOL_CATS/TOOL_KINDS registry should be extracted into e.g. src/lib/tools.js so ToolsDirectory/SiteMenu do not import a heavy section module.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (directory 4 groups + accordion + tool open/back, drawer kind grouping + close, cloud sync icon immediate + after reload, theme, site-menu & quick-tile regressions)

seed_data_creation: Temporary combo TEST_Cloud133 on admin@mikilab.de — DELETED; final GET /api/combos returns [] and localStorage mikilab_combos cleared.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Site menu trigger is data-testid 'site-menu-open' (Header.jsx) — 'site-menu' is the overlay itself. Combo hydration from the account happens only at APP BOOTSTRAP: clearing localStorage['mikilab_combos'] after load does NOT re-hydrate; you must clear then RELOAD, then click nav-tab-maestro. Onboarding coach bubble appears after most loads — dismiss with text=Skip (intro-close-btn is a different overlay). Directory accordion is exclusive (one open group at a time), 'genera' default.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no defects found. One intermediate script 'failure' (chip missing after clearing localStorage without reload) was a test-harness mistake: hydrateCombos runs only on bootstrap; re-run with a reload passed.
